message:
The other night, we had a surprise blackout that caught everyone off guard. I was the only one prepared with my trusty flashlight and a couple of power banks charged up and ready to go. As my family fumbled around looking for matches and candles (yikes!), I couldn't help but feel a little smug thinking, "I told you so!" But really, it was just nice to create a cozy atmosphere with the lanterns and get everyone gathered around for some good old-fashioned storytelling. 

It’s funny how a little preparation can turn a potentially frustrating moment into a fun memory. So, what’s your go-to tip for staying comfortable during a power outage? 🔦
